note: Known menu packages and the build targets they were actually observed to work on. Seeded from the 2026-09-22 harness experiment fixtures (backend/artifacts/harness-experiment-20260922). Independent of modellab: nothing here describes a costume or a fit.

policy.target_pass_requires: an entry in the package's `targets` whose required_signature_fields are ALL reported by the build and ALL equal, AND whose observation recorded which menu file it replaced (observed_base_menu_sha256). An observation that did not record its base menu certifies nothing beyond itself: one m-ex build behaving does not certify every customized m-ex menu, so that case is unknown. A vanilla-shaped menu file, matching root symbols, a filename or an author screenshot are NEVER sufficient evidence.
policy.structure_pass_requires: the file's own header, relocation table and root pointers all resolve inside its data section, the menu table carries a RELOCATED background-model pointer, and the native menu reader reopens it. A matching root NAME is not a structure check.
policy.codes_pass_requires: every required code resolved and valid, the COMPLETE final enabled set free of two codes writing one address different values, no code silently enabled, and no unmodelled opcode.
policy.unlisted_packages: may still be inspected, prepared and installed with an explicit override; they inherit nothing from a similar-looking package.
policy.background_semantics: The installed background is compared against roundtrip_background_sha256, the measured re-export digest. A package with no recorded re-export digest yields unknown for that check - never a failure, because DAT reserialization changing byte count does not mean the replacement failed.

digests.roundtrip_note: What the installed menu file's background bundle hashes to when the native reader exports it again. It is NOT the published bundle's digest: HSDRaw re-serializes, and that is harmless. Measured from runs/openrouter_z-ai_glm-5.3-flash/T5-halo-css/out/verify-roundtrip-background.dat.

structure.evidence: dat_root_symbols over the published Halo3CSS.dat returns exactly ['MnSelectChrDataTable']; the bundle re-exports at 359,190 B after DAT reserialization (backend/artifacts/harness-experiment-20260922/runs/*/T5-halo-css/out/)
